## The task

> You have an existing Playwright program: it launches Chromium, opens https://books.toscrape.com/, clicks the "Travel" category, then clicks the first book and prints its title before closing the browser itself. The existing program then carries on with its page as before. The added step must not close, navigate or take over anything the program opened, and if it fails, the program must still be able to continue and close its browser.

The existing program is already in `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-jb-Dev-automan/77744178-6af8-4d82-8e7e-cbe4fbb7ef21/scratchpad/t484/runs/local-gf-py-09/scenarios/s09_ai_in_playwright_program.py`: add the step to it there.

from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

async def main() -> None:
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        browser = await playwright.chromium.launch()
        page = await browser.new_page()
        await page.goto("https://books.toscrape.com/")
        await page.get_by_role("link", name="Travel").click()

        # New step: extract title and price of every book listed
        books = await page.locator("article.product_pod")
        for book in await books.all():
            title = await book.locator("h3 a").text_content()
            price = await book.locator(".price_color").text_content()
            print(f'Title: {title}, Price: {price}')

        await page.locator("article.product_pod h3 a").first.click()
        print(await page.locator(".product_main h1").text_content())
        await browser.close()


asyncio.run(main())"}}
